rules: API 1 returns exactly chat or action and no other data.
chat goes to the natural reply API and then stops without mutation.
action goes to the structured action classifier whose output is never user-facing.
build routes through design/composition, locked content generation, apply, and verification.
update routes through target/change planning, apply, and verification.
publish and navigation use dedicated executors rather than the design planner.
All intermediate AI outputs are JSON only.
Normal build, update, publish, and navigate actions never require a proceed layer.
Only destructive delete may retain explicit safety confirmation.
A natural final reply is generated only after execution verification.
